title: SMIB device-only 3PG ride-through: bus-39 synchronous machine vs REGFM_A1

grid.note: on each device OWN base; infinite bus held flat (no V/f step)

gfm.note: ImaxF=2.0 is the PNNL default; the 39-bus study used 1.5

results_headline.voltage: both recover within ~0.5 s against the strong grid (machine field-forces to ceiling)
results_headline.P_recovery: GFM snaps to Preq almost instantly; machine dips to ~0.1 pu and is still ~5% below dispatch at t=10 s (slow governor)
results_headline.frequency: both tight here; contrast emerges when the grid is weak or lost (islanded cases)
